metadata.case_name: LAW KING SANG AND ANOTHER v. LAW YIN SANG AND OTHERS

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: suited to much lighter work such as watchman, lift operator, messenger, clerk, cashier or indoor salesman

injuries.description: disc prolapse of L4-5 and L5-S1
source: The Plaintiff sprained and injured his back between the 4th and 5th floor levels of the building.
The Plaintiff was 31 years of age at the date of the accident and sustained a disc prolapse of L4-5 and L5-S1.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: unable to sit or stand for any lengthy period without getting pain over the lower lumber spine region
His sex life is affected by the back pain
he cannot lift heaving objects as he had been able to previously
He can no longer swim which he used to enjoy
assessed to have suffered a 20% loss of earning capacity
not mentally fit to work at present because of depressive disorder (psychiatric report by Dr S.Y. CHUNG)

treatments_received: treatment at Queen Elizabeth Hospital (quarterly check-ups)
treatments_future: psychiatric out-patient treatment every 2 weeks for one year (recommended by Dr S.Y. CHUNG)

losses.description: Plaintiff is unable to sit or stand for any lengthy period without getting pain over the lower lumber spine region.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: His sex life is affected by the back pain.
His lower grip is reduced and he cannot lift heaving objects as he had been able to previously.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He can no longer swim which he used to enjoy.
The Plaintiff has been assessed to have suffered a 20% loss of earning capacity.
